subject: executor: avoid scan row table if build is not finished in hash join v2 (#60531)
summary: The change replaces the previous implicit “scan unless explicitly skipped” behavior with an explicit `buildSuccess` gate, so HashJoinV2 only runs `scanRowTableAfterProbeDone()` when the build phase actually completed successfully (including the restore path where there is no standalone probe fetcher). This prevents scanning the row table in cases where the probe fetcher never waited for build completion (e.g., early exit/cancel) or where build failed, reducing risk of incorrect post-probe work on an unbuilt/failed hash table. No Blocker/High correctness or concurrency issues found in the updated control flow, and no later upstream/master commits modify this `buildSuccess` logic.
